subject: Horizon Talent candidate: scheduling and interviewer plan for Ali Nasir
messages:
From: Samira Khatri <samira@horizontalent.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: candidate for Senior ML Engineer (Ali Nasir) + slot windows

Hi Laura,

Quick intro — I'm Samira (Horizon Talent). I wanted to pass along Ali Nasir, an experienced applied ML engineer with recent work on transformer quantization and low-latency inference pipelines. Ali's currently open to new roles and is excited about Redwood's serving/runtime work.

I've attached Ali's resume and your public JD for reference. Candidate highlights:
- 7 years applied ML + systems (worked on production quantized models at scale)
- Experience building KV-cache invalidation and low-latency RPCs
- Comfortable with distributed GPU infra and perf tradeoffs

Proposed interview flow (we can adapt):
1) Recruiter screen (30m) — comp, availability, culture fit (Marissa)
2) Technical screen (60m) — systems + perf / design (Aditya)
3) Panel (60m) — modeling + product + reliability (Aditya, Karthik, Evelyn)

Ali's availability (PST):
- Tue Sep 1: 10:30 — 6:00, 15:00 — 6:00
- Wed Sep 2: 09:00 — 6:30

Can you confirm who should be on each interview and whether you want any prep packet or assignment sent ahead? I can lock the recruiter screen for Tue Sep 1 10:30 if that works.

Attachments: Candidate_Resume_Ali_Nasir.pdf, JD_Senior_ML_Engineer.pdf

Thanks,
Samira Khatri
Partner | Horizon Talent
T: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samira Khatri <samira@horizontalent.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: candidate for Senior ML Engineer (Ali Nasir) + slot windows

Thanks Samira — appreciate the intro and the brief. Ali looks like a good fit on paper.

Proposed interviewer assignments:
- Recruiter screen (30m): Marissa Cole — comp, notice period, culture fit
- Technical screen (60m): Aditya Rao — system design, perf tradeoffs, KV-cache behavior (please include a question about cache invalidation under TTL + multi-region replication)
- Panel (60m): Aditya + Karthik Iyer (product) + Evelyn Hart (infra reliability) — focus on latency budgets, quantization tolerances, and rollout/rollback plans

We want the recruiter screen at Tue Sep 1 10:30 PST if Ali confirms. Please include a 3-bullet strengths + 3 risk flags brief when you send the calendar invite so Marissa can prep. Also attach the job brief (JD_Senior_ML_Engineer.pdf) and our recruiter brief template (Redwood_Recruiter_Brief_Template.docx).

Marissa will follow up with the calendar hold. Aditya — can you confirm 60m availability on Tue Sep 1 afternoon or Wed Sep 2 morning?

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, ML Platform
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samira Khatri <samira@horizontalent.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: candidate for Senior ML Engineer (Ali Nasir) + slot windows

Hi Samira — happy to take the recruiter screen. Tue Sep 1 10:30 PST works for me as a hold.

Samira: please include in the invite:
- Candidate phone number and LinkedIn
- 3 bullets on strongest signals
- 3 potential concerns/context for the team

I'll run through comp bands and confirm relocation/notice during the call.

-Marissa
Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: candidate for Senior ML Engineer (Ali Nasir) + slot windows

Laura/Marissa — I can take the technical screen. My available windows:
- Tue Sep 1: 15:00 — 6:30 or 16:00 — 6:30 PST
- Wed Sep 2: 09:30 — 6:30 PST

Suggested rubric for the 60m screen:
- 10m: candidate background + previous infra projects
- 20m: system design (real-time inference path) — include prompts about quantized model accuracy under per-shard caching
- 20m: debugging/perf scenario — latency spike investigation + mitigation steps
- 10m: candidate questions + culture fit

I'll prepare a short whiteboard prompt around KV cache invalidation with multi-region staleness. If Samira can forward any code samples or notes, I can tailor the questions.

-Aditya
Senior Staff ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khatri <samira@horizontalent.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Ali Nasir <ali.nasir@gmail.com>, Horizon Talent Ops <ops@horizontalent.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: candidate for Senior ML Engineer (Ali Nasir) + slot windows

Thanks all — Ali confirmed the Tue Sep 1 10:30 recruiter screen. Calendar invite with join info and a short candidate brief is attached.

Candidate brief (quick):
- Strengths: strong quantization experience; built KV cache with sharded invalidation; low-latency RPC experience
- Risk flags: limited leadership experience running cross-team rollouts; prefers remote-first shops only
- Phone: +1 (650) 555-0103
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/alinasir

Attachments included in the invite: Candidate_Resume_Ali_Nasir.pdf, Redwood_Recruiter_Brief_Template.docx

See you Tue at 10:30. I can send a 15m pre-brief to the interviewers if you'd like.

Best,
Samira

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Quick debrief: recruiter screen outcome (Ali Nasir)

Team — quick notes post-screen:
- Ali joined on time; conversational and clear about recent infra work
- Confirmed notice: 4 weeks; open to negotiation on start date
- Compensation expectation: within our senior band (asked for clarity on equity mix)
- Flags: limited manager-level cross-team rollout examples (can probe in panel)

Recommend moving Ali to Aditya's technical screen. I'll queue the internal panel scheduling and share candidate prep notes (2 bullets on candidate background + 2 suggested technical prompts).

-Marissa
Recruiter | Redwood Inference
